NUTRITION AND ALLERGEN SPECIFICATION SHEET
Product: Harvest Grove Golden Granola Bar
Product Code: HG-GRN-014

Serving size: 40 g (about 1 bar). Servings per container: 6.

Nutrition Facts (per serving):
Total Fat 7 g (9% Daily Value).
Saturated Fat 1.5 g (8% Daily Value).
Sodium 95 mg (4% Daily Value).
Total Carbohydrate 27 g (10% Daily Value).
Dietary Fiber 3 g (11% Daily Value).
Vitamin D 1 mcg (6% Daily Value).

Water activity of the finished bar is 0.65-0.72 at 25 degrees Celsius. The pH of the fruit filling layer ranges from 4.2 to 4.8.

Shelf life under ambient storage conditions is 9 months from the date of manufacture. Under refrigerated storage, shelf life extends to 12 months from the date of manufacture.

Allergen statement: contains tree nuts (almonds, cashews) and milk. May contain peanuts and soy due to shared equipment.
